description: What relates to one stored item, and what happened to it. ref: a Message-ID or message URL, commit SHA or URL, docs URL or page.html, wiki URL or title, commitfest URL, CVE-YYYY-NNNNN, or feature:<words> (matched to commitfest titles and postgres commit subjects; ref.entries_used and ref.commits_used say which; no match gives empty results). Returns related threads, commits (with releases and reverted_by), docs, wiki pages, entries and people, each with why, strongest first: explicit links, shared identifiers, similar topic. For a postgres commit, thread, entry or feature, timeline gives status and dated events (first post, commitfest listings, commits with branch and first release, reverts) with source urls. ~3 s budget: late parts in timed_out. For feature:<words> and entries, graph lists stored design-history features (status, release shipped, decisions, positions), each fact with confidence, source and evidence ("probably" below 0.8, left out below 0.5). Same as GET /api/v2/related.

ref.description: e.g. 19705-548fda77321e062d@postgresql.org, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/brin.html, Don't Do This, b536d5a0bd7a, CVE-2024-10979, feature:incremental backup

version.description: Docs version for a page given without one, e.g. 17 (default current)

name: cross_reference
